description: This file provides utility functions for handling repository paths, parsing module specifiers in TypeScript source files, inventory management, and baseline checks within a project that manages code inventories and module dependencies.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a relative repository path with POSIX-style separators.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to a repository root, supporting relative and absolute specifiers.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file to locate and visit import, export, and dynamic import specifiers.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory entries, identifying missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Outputs a line of text to a given stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple TypeScript files, parses their source, and collects inventory entries.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline comparison of expected and actual inventory data, outputting results in JSON or human-readable format.
